Agent Name: Cubing_Expert
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the constraints by excluding green from consideration—asserting the missing edge “cannot involve blue or green” even though only blue pieces were fully found while for green only corners and green–yellow edges were guaranteed. This led to ruling out the actual missing edge (green–white) and concluding red–white; additionally, they misstated blue edge counts, indicating flawed piece accounting.
